QuestInfo.name: Ulrika's Offer 1
QuestInfo.1: #bUlrika#K wants you to collect #r30 Black Plastic Bags#k from the Dust Boxes. She'll introduce you to the Resistance if you do that... Head on over to #bEdelstein Strolling Path 4#k.
QuestInfo.2: #bUlrika#k is a member of the Resistance, so she can get you introduced. Better get those Black Plastic Bags from the Dust Boxes!

0.0: Yup, that's right, I'm a bona fide member of the #bResistance#k. Who'd suspect a kid, right? \r\n#L0##bI dunno. You give off a shady vibe...#l\n#k
0.1: Whatever. Here's my deal: You do me one tiny favor, and I'll show you the Resistance hideout. What do you say?\r\n#L0##bI say you're full of pink bean poop.#l\n#k
0.2:
You see anyone else willing to help you out? Didn't think so. Either do it my way or crawl on home to your Empress. Now, I need #r30 Black Plastic Bags#k, which you can get from Dust Boxes.
Then I'll introduce you to them. You'll find Dust Boxes in #bEdelstein Strolling Path 4#k. Good luck to you then!

#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to Edelstein Strolling Path 4 automatically.)#k#n

yes.0: You can find Dust Boxes on the #bEdelstein Strolling Path 4#k!\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to Edelstein Strolling Path 4 after you accept.)#n

no.0: Pssh, then go home, Cygnus Knight. No one wants you here anyway.

yes.0: Great! I can turn in my homework on time for once! Now, I just have one more thing for you to do, then I'll take you to the #bResistance#k hideout!
